# AI Usage 0.1.2
This release makes usage meaning and menu bar behavior explicit while keeping the panel compact and native.
- Switch every quota between **Used** and **Left** directly in the panel. - Show the selected meaning in both quota values and the menu bar. - Choose whether the menu bar tracks the current **Session** or **Weekly** limit. - Choose automatic refresh intervals of 1, 5, 15, 30, or 60 minutes. - Enable Launch at Login by default on the first launch from Applications, while respecting users who turn it off. - Show a direct **Update** action in the panel whenever Sparkle finds a newer release. - Remove the duplicated disclosure arrow from the Settings button.
The release also expands store, login, and compact-layout coverage for the new preferences.

# AI Usage 0.1.1
This release fixes startup for the current ad-hoc signed distribution.
Sparkle's embedded framework has its own code signature. Hardened Runtime library validation rejected that framework when the host app had only an ad-hoc signature, causing version 0.1.0 to exit before showing its menu bar item. Version 0.1.1 disables Hardened Runtime only for the unsigned fallback build. Developer ID signed releases continue to use Hardened Runtime and can be notarized normally.
All Claude Code, Codex, Liquid Glass, Launch at Login, and signed OTA features from 0.1.0 are unchanged.

# AI Usage 0.1.0
The first public release of AI Usage:
- Claude Code and Codex limits in one native macOS menu bar panel - Provider-specific monochrome menu bar icons - Compact Liquid Glass design for light and dark mode - Five-minute background refresh and one-click manual refresh - Launch at Login - Daily, EdDSA-signed over-the-air update checks powered by Sparkle
AI Usage reads the local sessions already created by Claude Code and Codex. It does not require another account or API key, and it does not collect telemetry.
This first build is ad-hoc signed because a Developer ID certificate is not available yet. macOS may ask you to confirm it once by right-clicking the app and choosing **Open**.
